block.voyager.blockhutvoyager.name: Departure Point
com.voyager.building.voyager.desc: Home of the Voyager, who leaves for the End on expeditions and returns with end stone, purpur, chorus, ender pearls and shulker shells. Build it as a Launchpad with a rocket or as an End Gate - the Voyager structure pack has both.
voyager:voyager.job.desc: Leaves for the End on expeditions and comes back with a haul of End treasures and a story to tell. A very dangerous job - pack armor, a sword, a pickaxe and rations!
voyager:voyager.skills.desc: Adaptability shapes what they find, Agility the odds of coming home unhurt.
Where no colonist has gone before
com.voyager.chat.unreachable: I can't get to the departure point! Is the way to the rocket or the dais blocked?
death.attack.voyager.the_end.player: %1$s was lost in the End while fighting %2$s
com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.voyager: Leaves for the End on expeditions and returns with End loot. Every trip costs supplies, and not every Voyager comes home.
com.voyager.research.effects.void_insura: Voyagers take %3$s%% less damage in the End
com.voyager.research.effects.starlight_n: One more expedition per launch window
com.voyager.research.effects.shulker_whi: Every shulker a Voyager beats leaves an extra shell
com.voyager.research.effects.ender_harve: Every enderman a Voyager beats leaves an extra ender pearl
com.voyager.research.effects.dragon_hunt: Level 5 Voyagers may run into the dragon - and bring home her head
com.voyager.research.effects.long_range_: Voyagers report to the colony chat while they are away
com.voyager.research.effects.return_to_s: A lost Voyager's gear is brought back to the Departure Point
com.voyager.research.technology.void_ins: Terms and conditions apply beyond the edge of the world
Now also covering shulker fire and acts of dragon
com.voyager.research.technology.starligh: Second star to the right, and straight on till morning
com.voyager.research.technology.rapid_re: A pit stop at the edge of the void
com.voyager.research.technology.ender_ha: Pearls of the void, picked fresh
com.voyager.research.technology.shulker_: They open up if you ask nicely
com.voyager.research.technology.dragon_h: There is always a bigger fish
